unit_economics.workload_assumptions: HYPOTHESIS: 100 pages, two scans per release, 20 findings, and 15 minutes of triage per finding.
unit_economics.model_calls: HYPOTHESIS: one small-model classification call per finding and one summary call per release; tokens are unmeasured.
unit_economics.infrastructure_calls: HYPOTHESIS: browser execution, CI minutes, storage, and report delivery; rates are unmeasured.
unit_economics.human_review_exposure: FACT: W3C evaluation guidance requires human evaluation alongside automated tools.
unit_economics.cost_range: HYPOTHESIS: about $0.03 per modeled release at 60,000 input and 12,000 output tokens on GPT-5.6 Luna pricing, with a $0.03-$0.30 model-only sensitivity range; browser, storage, and five hours of review are excluded and UNKNOWN.
unit_economics.pricing_hypothesis: HYPOTHESIS: repository or release tiers could be tested; no buyer spending is claimed.
unit_economics.gross_margin_risks: HYPOTHESIS: browser flake, retries, and expert review could dominate cost.
unit_economics.cheaper_fallback: HYPOTHESIS: deterministic Axe/WCAG checks in existing CI with human review and optional local summarization.

unit_economics.workload_assumptions: HYPOTHESIS: 30-minute job recording, 20 jobs per technician per week, and one correction pass per record.
unit_economics.model_calls: HYPOTHESIS: realtime transcription plus structured extraction per job; token and audio rates are unmeasured.
unit_economics.infrastructure_calls: HYPOTHESIS: mobile audio transport, storage, integration, and support; rates are unmeasured.
unit_economics.human_review_exposure: HYPOTHESIS: supervisors review low-confidence records; review time is unmeasured.
unit_economics.cost_range: HYPOTHESIS: about $0.04 per technician-week for 100,000 input and 20,000 output text tokens on GPT-5.6 Luna pricing, with a $0.05-$0.50 text-model sensitivity range; realtime audio, storage, integration, support, and review are excluded and UNKNOWN.
unit_economics.pricing_hypothesis: HYPOTHESIS: per-technician subscription could be tested; no buyer spending is claimed.
unit_economics.gross_margin_risks: HYPOTHESIS: long audio, retries, noisy environments, support, and integration work could dominate cost.
unit_economics.cheaper_fallback: HYPOTHESIS: push-to-talk transcription using existing mobile dictation with deterministic templates.

unit_economics.workload_assumptions: HYPOTHESIS: one packet per authorization, 10 source documents, and 20 minutes of human verification.
unit_economics.model_calls: HYPOTHESIS: extraction and citation calls per document; token rates and error rates are unmeasured.
unit_economics.infrastructure_calls: HYPOTHESIS: secure storage, audit logging, integration, and delivery; costs are unmeasured.
unit_economics.human_review_exposure: HYPOTHESIS: qualified staff review every packet before submission; staffing cost is unmeasured.
unit_economics.cost_range: HYPOTHESIS: about $0.01 per packet for 50,000 input and 3,000 output tokens on GPT-5.6 Luna pricing, with a $0.02-$0.20 model-only sensitivity range; compliant storage, integration, security, rework, and 20 minutes of review are excluded and UNKNOWN.
unit_economics.pricing_hypothesis: HYPOTHESIS: per-packet or workflow pricing could be tested only after authorization; no buyer spending is claimed.
unit_economics.gross_margin_risks: HYPOTHESIS: human verification, integration, security, and rework could dominate cost.
unit_economics.cheaper_fallback: HYPOTHESIS: deterministic document checklist and citation template with no model handling of patient records.
